summary: Verified the Phase 2 rmcp gateway replacement is complete: rmcp Streamable HTTP service mounted at /mcp implementing ServerHandler, bearer-token auth wrapping the full service (401 challenge with public resource_metadata), all nine tools ported to typed SDK handlers, calendar_list permission mapping corrected, loopback constants removed, and the custom dispatcher retired to test-only use. All 249 tests pass with a clean compile.
follow_up: A concurrent process (prior session) was still modifying mcp-server files during verification (gateway.rs dead-code removal, output_schema.rs, and caldav worktree changes were reverted). State was confirmed stable before final verification, but a later stage should re-run cargo test to confirm no further drift.
Rate limiter (rate_limiter.rs) is a stub that always allows; real rate limiting is deferred to Slice 14 per the in-code note.

The retired custom dispatcher (Gateway::handle_authorized_tool_call) is retained solely to exercise audit-recording integration tests; if the dispatcher is later deleted, those three audit tests in tests/integration.rs must be re-pointed at the rmcp path.
important_context: Phase 2 was largely implemented by a prior session; this stage verified compile + tests + acceptance criteria rather than authoring the change.
Validated identity is carried via a tokio task-local (identity::IDENTITY) set by auth middleware and read by rmcp tool handlers; this is the concurrency-isolation mechanism.
calendar_list is gated by grant.allow_availability via its own check_tool_permission('calendar_list') entry, distinct from availability_find.
Production route is rmcp StreamableHttpService at /mcp wrapped by auth::auth_middleware; the old JSON-RPC dispatcher in gateway.rs is no longer wired into main.rs.
